title: Crispy Ethiopian Mozzarella Croquettes
description: A crispy French-inspired twist on traditional cheese croquettes, incorporating the flavors of Ethiopia.
instructions: In a bowl, mix together jjigae paste, nutty cheese, flour, and eggs until well combined.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Heat a non-stick pan with a small amount of oil over medium heat.
Using a spoon, drop small portions of the cheese mixture into the pan.
Shape the mixture into small patties. If the mixture is too wet, add a bit more flour.
Fry the patties until they're golden brown on both sides.
Transfer the croquettes to a plate lined with paper towels to drain excess oil.
Dip the croquettes in crispy breadcrumbs for an added crunch.
Serve the crispy Ethiopian mozzarella croquettes immediately and enjoy!
Optional: sprinkle with a pinch of nutmeg for extra flavor.
